description:
Clean Harbors is seeking a motivated, technically minded Associate Data & Analytics Developer to join our Enterprise Applications team. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent college graduate or early-career professional looking to build a career in enterprise data analytics, business intelligence, and cloud technologies. 
 In this role, you will work with Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI), a cloud-based analytics platform used to deliver financial, operational, and business insights across the organization. 
 You will gain hands-on experience developing reports and dashboards, working with enterprise data, writing SQL queries, and supporting analytics solutions across Oracle Cloud applications. 
 Prior experience with Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence is not required. We are looking for someone with a strong technical foundation, curiosity, analytical thinking, and a willingness to learn. 
  
 Why work for Clean Harbors? 
 Health and Safety is our #1 priority and we live it 3-6-5! 

 Competitive wages 

 Comprehensive health benefits coverage after 30 days of full-time employment 

 Group 401K with company matching component 

 Own part of Clean Harbors with our Employee Stock Purchase Plan 

 Generous paid time off, company paid training and tuition reimbursement 
 Positive and safe work environments 
 Opportunities for growth and development for all the stages of your career 

 
 Assist in developing, configuring, and maintaining analytics solutions using Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI). 
 Write, test, and troubleshoot SQL queries to retrieve, analyze, and validate data. 
 Help develop dashboards, reports, metrics, and visualizations to support business decision-making. 
 Support data integration activities involving Oracle Cloud applications and other enterprise systems. 
 Assist with data modeling, data transformations, and data quality validation. 
 Learn to configure and enhance FDI subject areas, data augmentations, and semantic models. 
 Support troubleshooting and resolution of reporting, data accuracy, and integration issues. 
 Assist with testing, documentation, and deployment of new analytics solutions and enhancements. 
 Collaborate with IT team members and business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements. 
 Participate in ongoing improvements to analytics performance, reliability, and usability. 
 Develop an understanding of enterprise applications and business processes across Finance, Supply Chain, Human Resources, and Customer Experience. 
 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent technical education and experience. 
 0–2 years of relevant experience. Recent college graduates and candidates with internship, academic project, or equivalent hands-on experience are encouraged to apply. 
 Foundational knowledge of SQL and relational databases, including writing queries, joins, filtering, and aggregations. 
 Basic understanding of data analysis, database concepts, and data structures. 
 Familiarity with data visualization, reporting, or business intelligence concepts. 
 Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills. 
 Interest in learning cloud-based enterprise applications and analytics technologies. 
 Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and nontechnical colleagues. 
 Strong attention to detail, initiative, and willingness to learn new tools and technologies. 
 Preferred Qualifications (Not Required) 
 Exposure through coursework, internships, personal projects, or professional experience to any of the following is beneficial: 
 SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL. 
 Business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Oracle Analytics. 
 Programming or scripting languages such as Python. 
 Data modeling, data warehousing, ETL, or data integration concepts. 
 Cloud technologies, including Oracle Cloud, AWS, or Azure. 
 ERP or enterprise business applications. 
 Data analytics, database development, or reporting projects. 
  
 Candidates are not expected to have experience with all of these technologies. 
 What You'll Learn 
 This position provides an opportunity to develop practical experience in: 
 Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence and Oracle Analytics Cloud. 
 Enterprise data warehousing and SQL development. 
 Data integration, transformation, and validation. 
 Business intelligence dashboards and reporting. 
 Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, SCM, HCM, and CX applications. 
 Enterprise application security and data access. 
 The software development lifecycle, testing, and deployment. 
 Translating real-world business requirements into technical solutions. 
  
 Wondering what to expect in starting your career with Clean Harbors?   Click Here  to view a Day in the Life Video! 
  
 40-years of sustainability in action.  At Clean Harbors, our mission is to create a safer, cleaner environment through the treatment, recycling, and disposal of hazardous materials.  Clean Harbors is the leading provider of environmental, energy and industrial services throughout the United States, Canada, Mexico and Puerto Rico.   Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. We are solving tough problems through innovation and proven methodology – come be part of the solution with us.  
  
 Join our safety focused team today!   To learn more about our company, and to apply online for this exciting opportunity, visit us at  https://careers.cleanharbors.com/ .  
  
 Clean Harbors is an equal opportunity employer.  
  
 Clean Harbors is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, contact  ect@cleanharbors.com or 1-844-922-5547.  
  
 Clean Harbors is a Military & Veteran friendly company.  
  
 Please be advised that Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used to support certain stages of the recruitment process but are not used as a replacement for human decision making.  
  
 Clean Harbors is committed to complying with applicable pay transparency laws and ensuring fair and equitable compensation. The posted salary range reflects the minimum and maximum target for this role. Final compensation may vary based on factors such as location, experience, skills, and business needs. In addition to the base salary, some roles may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package.
